Description: Kerala Drowning Research Dataset — Starter Pack
Starter research dataset. It is NOT a complete incident-level dataset.
Blank values mean unknown/not yet sourced. They do NOT mean zero.
No incident-level records, coordinates or timestamps have been fabricated.
Do not train an incident classifier from blank templates or aggregated annual totals.
Request anonymised incident-level records from Kerala Police, Fire & Rescue Services or SDMA, then match to hydrology.
Do not collect names, phone numbers or other personal identifiers.
